sections.section_title: How to program the watchdog timeout
sections.text_helper: Section 20.4 "How to program the watchdog timeout" in chapter 20 (Window watchdog (WWDG)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 502.
sections.section_content:
Warning: When writing to the WWDG_CR register, always write 1 in the
T6 bit to avoid generating an immediate reset.
[Figure 184. Window watchdog timing diagram]
The formula to calculate the WWDG timeout value is given by:
WDGTB[1:0]
tWWDG = tPCLK1×4096×2 ×(T[5:0]+1) (ms)
where:
tWWDG: WWDG timeout
tPCLK1: APB1 clock period measured in ms
4096: value corresponding to internal divider
As an example, let us assume APB1 frequency is equal to 24MHz, WDGTB[1:0] is set to 3
and T[5:0] is set to 63:
3
tWWDG = 1⁄24000×4096×2 ×(63+1) = 21.85ms
Refer to Table98 for the minimum and maximum values of the tWWDG.
[Table 98. Minimum and maximum timeout values @36 MHz (fPCLK1)]
